samples.summary: e2e auth helpers hardcode the bare `wafflebase_session` cookie name that `jwt.strategy` no longer necessarily reads
samples.evidence: `packages/backend/src/auth/jwt.strategy.ts:19` now derives the accepted cookie name from `sessionCookieName()` → `useSecureCookies()`, which reads `COOKIE_SECURE` first and then `GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL`'s scheme. Six e2e suites still build the auth header as a literal bare name: `packages/backend/test/authenticated-http.e2e-spec.ts:48`, `notification.e2e-spec.ts:49`, `user-doc-styles.e2e-spec.ts:46`, `api-key-http.e2e-spec.ts:46`, `document-file-serving.e2e-spec.ts:50`, `folder.e2e-spec.ts:53`. `packages/backend/test/helpers/integration-helpers.ts:93` only sets the callback URL with `??=`, so any environment that already exports `COOKIE_SECURE=true` or an `https://` `GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL` (both documented, self-hosting.md:135/140) flips the accepted name to `__Host-wafflebase_session` and every authenticated e2e request 401s. The fix belongs in the helpers (derive the name, or pin `COOKIE_SECURE=false` for the integration lane).

samples.summary: Error emitters left unattributed after `command` became part of the envelope contract, so the attribution an agent branches on still depends on which subcommand ran
samples.evidence: The change makes `command` part of the documented envelope (docs/design/cli.md:1492-1504, "one line, attributed" for `outputError` and friends) and attributes `ctx switch`, but three sibling emitters were left calling the one-argument form: `packages/cli/src/commands/ctx.ts:85` (`ctx list`, which reports the *same* `NOT_LOGGED_IN` condition the diff's own comment says must not differ per subcommand), `packages/cli/src/commands/status.ts:69`, and `packages/cli/src/commands/cells.ts:139` (the `sheets cells batch` malformed-JSON envelope — the same file whose other emitters were updated to `outputError(e, this)` at lines 35/76/103/173).

samples.summary: Two new login tests run the real `runLogin` without pointing `WAFFLEBASE_CONFIG` at a temp dir, so `announceLoginUrl` writes into the developer's real config directory
samples.evidence: `announceLoginUrl` (packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts:152) writes `login-url.txt` beside `getConfigPath()` whenever stderr is not a TTY — always true under vitest. Only the first test in the new suite sets `process.env.WAFFLEBASE_CONFIG` (login-callback.test.ts:265), and the shared `afterEach` deletes it (line 258), so the 'reports a rejected exchange' test at line 356 and the 'codes a backend 5xx' test at line 433 drive `registerLoginCommand`'s action against the real `~/.wafflebase` path. The other suites were updated for exactly this (login.test.ts:429, login-command.test.ts:141).

samples.summary: OAuth-state callback specs still key on the literal `wafflebase_oauth_state` name without pinning the env that now decides it
samples.evidence: `isSecureCookie()` (packages/backend/src/auth/oauth-state.ts:230) now answers from `COOKIE_SECURE`/`GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL` rather than `NODE_ENV`, and `oauthStateCookieName()` follows it. The diff added env pinning to the cookie-policy and logout describes but not to the callback-state describe, which passes a hardcoded bare cookie at packages/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.spec.ts:403/446/476 and asserts the bare name at :412 — so a shell with `COOKIE_SECURE=true` or an https callback URL flips the name and these pass/fail by environment, the exact failure mode the diff's own comments call out.

samples.summary: `login_state` is added to the frontend error vocabulary but no backend code path emits it
samples.evidence: The only `?error=` values the backend redirects with are `oauth_state`: `packages/backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts:149` and `:167` (built by `loginErrorUrl` at :322). A repo-wide grep finds `login_state` only in the frontend map and its test, plus a task note (docs/tasks/active/20260812-cli-login-loopback-binding-todo.md:158). The extra entry is dead vocabulary that will drift; harmless today but it makes the map look like a live contract with the backend.
